answer: Submissions that land within 30 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. The fable detector writes to sable, and forge shows every merge. A farm scripting its whole swarm fires them together, and as a result the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 263 aliases out burns the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 9 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
